info.title: Communiti API
info.description:
One REST API for the CommUniti member web app, admin dashboard and mobile app.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Access tokens last 15 minutes.
Web clients get the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie; mobile clients (`X-Client: ios|android`) get it in the response body and send it back to `/auth/refresh`.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "fields?", "requestId" } }`.

**Pagination.** Lists return `{ data, nextCursor }`; pass `?cursor=<nextCursor>` for the next page. Admin tables use `?page=&pageSize=`.

**Sign-up and onboarding.** `POST /auth/register` → `POST /auth/verify-email` (signs in) → `GET /me/onboarding` tells you the next screen: `select_role` → `PUT /me/role` (Researcher / Innovator / Professional / Learner form), `interests` → `PUT /me/interests`, `done` → the app. Role forms are reviewed by admins (`verificationStatus`: pending → verified / rejected); `verified: true` on any user means show the verified badge.

**Uploads.** `POST /uploads/presign` → `PUT` the bytes → `POST /uploads/{id}/complete`, then pass the `mediaId` (or `publicUrl` for avatars and covers).

**Maintenance.** `GET /app-config` on start-up; a `503 MAINTENANCE` response means show the maintenance screen.

Screen-by-screen guides: `docs/USER_API.md` (member apps) and `docs/ADMIN_API.md` (admin dashboard) in the API repository.

get.summary: Public app configuration (image prefetching, maintenance banner)
get.description: No auth. Clients call it on start-up to show a maintenance banner, and when any call returns `503 MAINTENANCE`.

post.summary: Create an account with email and password
post.description: Create account screen: full name, email, location, password, confirm password, terms. Creates an unverified account and emails a 6-digit code (then POST /auth/verify-email). Retrying with an unverified email updates the details and resends the code. After sign-in, GET /me/onboarding says which onboarding screen comes next.

password.description: 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one number

confirmPassword.description: "Confirm password". When sent, it must match `password`

post.summary: Verify email with the 6-digit code and sign in
post.description: On success the user is signed in. Next step: onboarding (`PATCH /me/onboarding`) when `user.onboardingComplete` is false.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Errors: `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (a new code is emailed), `PASSWORD_NOT_SET` (Google-only account), `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (5 failed attempts, 15 min), `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`, `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`.
Web: sends the httpOnly cookie automatically (use `credentials: "include"`). Mobile: send `{ refreshToken }`. The refresh token rotates on every call.

refreshToken.description: Mobile only. Web sends the httpOnly cookie automatically.

get.description: Open this URL in the browser (full-page navigation, not fetch). Redirects to Google, then back to `/auth/google/callback`, which sets the refresh cookie and redirects to `{WEB_URL|ADMIN_URL}/auth/callback`. The frontend then calls `POST /auth/refresh` to get an access token.

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Which frontend to return to after sign-in

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Relative path in the frontend to land on after sign-in, e.g. /projects

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token (mobile apps, Google One Tap)
post.description: Verifies the ID token against the web and mobile client IDs. Creates the account on first sign-in (`isNewUser: true`).

idToken.description: Google ID token from the native / One Tap sign-in SDK

post.summary: Forgot password: email a reset code
post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the email is registered.

post.summary: Verify the reset code and get a reset token
Set a new password with the reset token
post.description: Signs the user out of every device and emails a confirmation. The user then signs in with the new password.

newPassword.description: 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one number

post.summary: Change password (or set one for a Google-only account)
post.description: Keeps this device signed in and signs out every other device.

currentPassword.description: Required unless the account has no password yet (Google-only)

newPassword.description: 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one number

get.summary: Current user with profile, counts and interests

patch.description: Edit Profile: profile name (`fullName`), profession (`headline`), avatar (upload with POST /uploads/presign, purpose `avatar`, then pass `avatarUrl`). Settings: `location`, `phone`. Changing role here clears verification (`verificationStatus: unverified`); to change role with its form ("Change my role"), use PUT /me/role. Institutional email and research details are changed through PUT /me/role too, which sends them for review again.

delete.description: Signs out everywhere and schedules permanent deletion in 30 days. Signing in before then cancels it. Accounts with a password must confirm it.

patch.description: Earlier single-step flow, kept for existing clients. The current flow is PUT /me/role (Select Role + role form) then PUT /me/interests; use GET /me/onboarding to know the next step. `dateOfBirth` and `country` are now optional.

get.summary: Onboarding progress (where to send the member after sign-in)
get.description: `nextStep`: `select_role` → Select Role + role form (PUT /me/role), `interests` → "One more thing!" (PUT /me/interests), `done` → the app.

put.summary: Submit my role and its verification form (Select Role → Researcher / Innovator / Professional / Learner)
put.description: Onboarding step 1, and Settings → "Change my role" / "Change this email". Body: `{ memberRole, details }`; `details` depends on the role: **researcher**: `institutionalEmail` or `orcidId` (at least one), `researchProjectLink`, `researchEvidence`. **innovator**: `ventureName`, `description`, `developmentStage` (open | ongoing | closed), `evidenceLink`, `evidenceFileIds`, `otherCueFileIds` (upload with purpose `verification`). **professional**: `organizationName`, `professionalTitle`, `profileLink`, `workEmail`. **learner**: `institution`, `courseOfStudy`, `studentEmail`, `level`. Every submission sets `verificationStatus: pending` until an admin reviews it (the account stays usable). Completes onboarding when interests are already chosen.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page (`nextCursor`)
